lines: Club creation is admin-only — users can only request membership.
Club name, City, Head → Create club (top bar)
The new head takes over; the old head retires.
Club, New head → Change head Takes effect immediately.

For one person who ended up with two accounts and cannot sign in to both. The account that heads a club is kept, or else the older one; it gets the other's history, clubs, head positions and sign-in methods. It cannot be undone.
Account, Same person's other account → Merge accounts Refused when both took part in the same session.

blocks.text: is_admin only; archived clubs vanish everywhere else (404) and stay here. Changing the head also removes the old head as engine owner, so that account can be merged later.
